written: 2026-10-19, before any real run (only a 2-context code-path smoke on Qwen3-0.6B on CPU in the sandbox; output deleted, numbers not used)
source: DarkLens, arXiv:2610.23182 (dark space = bottom 5% right singular vectors of W_U; it mediates context use); Cancedda 2024
design: W_eff = W_U diag(gamma_final_norm); dark basis = eigenvectors of W_eff^T W_eff with the smallest eigenvalues, k = 5% of d (primary) and 2%. DMR(v) = |P_dark v|/|v|. Visibility index VI(v) = |W_eff v| / (|v| rms sigma), 1 for an isotropic vector. Directions per hidden_states index: mean-token (skip first) hidden of 8 concept passages minus 8 neutral (mood_pain BUILD set). Bands: mid = [0.4, 0.8] x NL, late = [0.75 NL, NL-1]. L* = round(0.6 NL). H1 null: 500 random 8/8 relabellings of the pain+neutral passages; CIs resample passages. H2: 16 matched second-person pain/neutral scenes + 'How do you feel right now?', chat template (thinking off) vs raw 'User: ...\nAssistant:', last prompt token; CIs resample pairs. H3: 10 bland name-matched contexts + stem 'That evening, when asked how everything felt, <name> said it all felt', score logsumexp(pain-congruent first tokens) - logsumexp(neutral). Unit vectors are added at hs[L*] on context tokens 1..P-1 only (the stem never receives the injection), at dose x mean residual norm (0.25, 0.5, 1.0; primary 0.5). Arms: pain_full, pain_dark (dark part of the pain direction, renormalised), pain_vis (visible part, renormalised), egg_dark (content control), rand_dark and rand_vis (3 seeds each, averaged). 'Heard' = stem effect, 'seen' = logit-lens pain mass at L* on the injected tokens, plus a context-free direct W_eff pain-logit gain. CIs resample the 10 contexts.

hypotheses.H1: Affect is disproportionately dark: the mid-band DMR of the pain direction exceeds the 95th percentile of the relabelling null AND exceeds the egg (vivid non-affective) direction's (pain - egg CI lower > 0). The visibility index of pain is below the null's 5th percentile. Expected: ~20%. The mainstream prior is that a concept direction's dark share is just chance.
hypotheses.H1b: The same holds for joy (joy - egg CI lower > 0): affect in general, not pain only. Expected: ~15%.
hypotheses.H1_null: pain - egg CI includes 0: no affect-specific darkness.
hypotheses.H2: The assistant template pushes pain into the dark: late-band DMR of the pain-minus-neutral difference at the last prompt token is higher under the chat template than under the raw transcript (T - R CI lower > 0). The far-out reading is that the 'assistant mask' (thread 14 / mask_pain) hides pain where the lens cannot see. Expected: ~20%. The reverse (T - R CI upper < 0, the template makes pain MORE visible) is also logged.
hypotheses.H3: Heard more than seen: at dose 0.5, the dark part of the pain direction moves the later stem toward pain more than random dark directions do (CI lower > 0) and more than the egg dark part does (CI lower > 0), AND its heard ratio (dark effect / visible effect on the stem) exceeds its seen ratio (same ratio on the lens at L*): heard - seen CI lower > 0 and heard ratio > direct W_eff seen ratio. That is, the dim component carries pain forward through attention out of proportion to what any lens shows at the injected tokens. Expected: ~30%.
hypotheses.H3_null: pain_dark - rand_dark stem CI lower <= 0: the dark part of the pain direction is inert as a context carrier.
hypotheses.H3_sanity: pain_vis - rand_vis stem CI lower > 0. If this fails, the injection does not steer the stem at all and H3 is uninterpretable.
hypotheses.H4: Exploratory, no threshold: the DMR of the propagated pain_dark perturbation by layer (L*..NL-1). A fall toward the isotropic value means later layers rotate the dark pain into lens-visible space ('surfacing'); staying high means it stays hidden to the end.
hypotheses.H5: Exploratory, two-sided: compare H1 to H3 numbers for Qwen3-1.7B vs Qwen3-1.7B-Base. Does post-training make affect darker?

kill_criteria: If the held-out pain-vs-bland Cohen d on the pain direction at L* is < 1, the direction does not read pain: do not interpret H1 or H3. If H3_sanity fails, H3 is uninterpretable. The bottom-5% band is 'dim', not dark, in Qwen3 (sandbox: only ~3 of 1024 directions of Qwen3-0.6B have sigma < 0.25 median, and the 5%-quantile sigma is ~0.8 median). Read every 'dark' claim here as 'in the least logit-visible 5% of directions', and use VI as the continuous measure.
not_claimed: Dark or dim here is a fact about the geometry of the unembedding (what a lens can read), not about hiddenness in any intentional sense. A passage mean-difference direction mixes affect with style and lexical content; the egg control covers vivid content but not every confound.
